title: Warm Crispy Thai Corn Tortillas Kanom Jeen
description: A lazy-sunday Thai dish featuring corn tortillas and double-fry KFC, low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Double-fry the KFC in the hot oil until crispy, about 3-4 minutes. Set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp of sesame oil in the same pan over medium heat. Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the low-sodium fish sauce and palm sugar to the pan and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lime juice to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, heat another 1 cup of vegetable oil in a separate pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the corn tortillas in batches until crispy and golden brown, about 30 seconds to 1 minute per side.
Drain the fried tortillas on paper towels and sprinkle with low-sodium salt and black pepper to taste.
Assemble the dish by placing a fried tortilla on a plate, topping with a piece of double-fry KFC, and garnishing with chopped cilantro, scallions, crushed peanuts, and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
